name: enable_indexscan
description: Controls whether the query planner considers index-scan plan types when generating execution plans.
symptoms: Unnecessarily slow point queries on indexed columns
Excessive sequential scans on large tables
Higher CPU and I/O usage for selective queries
tuning_tips: Leave enabled ('on') unless diagnosing planner misestimation issues; disable ('off') only temporarily for testing or to force sequential scans in rare cases where index usage leads to poor performance due to inaccurate statistics or cost model assumptions.
